title: SALD: Self-Referenced Advantage Learning for Diffusion Models
title_zh: SALD：扩散模型的自参考优势学习

paragraphs.en: Recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that single models can obtain informative training signals by evaluating their behavior in demonstration- or feedback-augmented contexts, with the help of a teacher network, which is driven by the students’ learned parameters. Inspired by this internal-reference principle, we investigate how diffusion models can identify self-referenced training signals without external demonstrations or teacher networks. We introduce SALD, a self-referenced training framework that evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels using the same model. The easier, lower-noise path is evaluated without gradient tracking to provide a reference, while the harder, higher-noise path provides the training gradient. Rather than directly distilling the easy-path prediction, SALD uses the difference between two path errors to adapt the hard-path objective. The proposed Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts this relative error into a differentiable sample-level weight. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) accumulates relative difficulty across training and adapts the future gap between the two noise levels. Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) further compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight. All components share a single set of model parameters, requiring neither an external teacher network nor additional trainable parameters during training or inference, and no modification to the inference procedure. Experiments across multiple architectures and datasets demonstrate consistent improvements in generation quality, while component-wise ablations quantify the contributions of the proposed components.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于语言模型自适应的研究表明，在教师网络的辅助下，单个模型可以通过评估其在增强演示或反馈上下文中的行为来获取信息丰富的训练信号，而该教师网络则由学生模型学到的参数驱动。 受这一内部参考原则的启发，我们研究了扩散模型如何在没有外部演示或教师网络的情况下识别自我引用的训练信号。 我们提出了 SALD，一种自我引用训练框架，它使用同一模型在两个噪声水平上评估每一对图像与描述。 较简单、噪声较低的路径无需梯度追踪即可进行评估以提供参考，而更难、噪声较高的路径则提供训练梯度。 SALD 并未直接蒸馏简单路径的预测结果，而是利用两条路径误差之间的差异来调整困难路径的目标函数。 所提出的优势引导扩散（AGD）方法将这种相对误差转化为一个可微分的样本级权重。 时间优势记忆（TAM）模块在整个训练过程中积累相对难度，并据此调整未来两个噪声水平之间的差距。 谱优势分解（SAD）模块进一步比较两条路径的残差功率谱，并构建一个基于频率的可微分潜在元素权重。 所有组件共享一组模型参数，因此训练和推理阶段既不需要外部教师网络，也不需要额外的可训练参数，且无需对推理流程进行任何修改。 在多种架构和数据集上进行的实验表明，该方法能持续提升生成质量，而各组件的消融分析则量化了所提出组件的具体贡献。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion Ho et al. (2020) ; Song et al. (2020) and flow-matching Lipman et al. (2022) ; Albergo et al. (2025) based generative models have become standard backbones for high-fidelity image synthesis, with Diffusion Transformers further improving scalability and generation quality Peebles and Xie (2023) . In parallel, recent work on language-model adaptation has shown that a model can obtain richer online training signals by evaluating its behavior under additional information. Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning conditions a self-teacher on expert demonstrations, whereas Self-Distillation Policy Optimization conditions a self-teacher on feedback obtained from the model’s own attempts Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) . These approaches show that useful supervision can be constructed without relying on a stronger external teacher. Transferring this principle to diffusion training is not straightforward: diffusion models do not naturally receive textual demonstrations or retrospective feedback, and their training states are sampled from a prescribed corruption process rather than from autoregressive policy rollouts. Moreover, standard diffusion objectives still average gradients uniformly across training pairs and latent elements, although their difficulty varies substantially across images, captions, noise levels, and visual details Vincent (2011) ; Choi et al. (2022) . Neural networks also exhibit spectral bias, learning coarse low-frequency structure before fine high-frequency detail Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Wang and Pehlevan (2025a) . Consequently, uniform training can continue to emphasize already learned signals while underweighting examples and visual components that remain difficult.
paragraphs.zh: Diffusion Ho 等人（2020）、Song 等人（2020）以及流匹配方法 Lipman 等人（2022）、Albergo 等人（2025）所基于的生成模型，已成为高保真图像合成的标准主干架构，而扩散变换器（Diffusion Transformers）则进一步提升了其可扩展性和生成质量（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）。与此同时，近期关于语言模型自适应的研究表明，通过评估模型在额外信息条件下的行为，模型可以获得更丰富的在线训练信号。自我蒸馏微调（Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning）将自教师模型的条件建立在专家演示之上，而自我蒸馏策略优化（Self-Distillation Policy Optimization）则将其条件建立在模型自身尝试所获得的反馈之上（Shenfeld 等人，2026；Hübotter 等人，2026）。这些方法表明，无需依赖更强大的外部教师，也可以构建出有效的监督信号。然而，将这一原则迁移到扩散模型训练中并非易事：扩散模型天然并不接收文本演示或事后反馈，其训练状态是从预定的扰动过程中采样得到的，而非来自自回归策略的展开过程。此外，标准的扩散目标函数仍然对训练样本对和潜在变量元素均匀地平均计算梯度，尽管这些样本和变量在图像、描述、噪声水平和视觉细节方面的难度存在显著差异（Vincent，2011；Choi 等人，2022）。神经网络还存在谱偏置问题，即会先学习粗糙的低频结构，再学习精细的高频细节（Rahaman 等人，2019；Wang 和 Pehlevan，2025a）。因此，均匀的训练方式可能会持续强调已经学到的信号，同时低估那些仍然具有挑战性的样本和视觉成分。

paragraphs.en: A unified answer remains missing because existing methods address only parts of this problem. Noise-level weighting Karras et al. (2022) ; Esser et al. (2024) ; Hang et al. (2025) adjusts training according to timestep or signal-to-noise ratio, but normally applies the same rule to all examples evaluated at a given noise level. Noise selection methods show that different noise instances provide unequal training signals Qi et al. (2024a) , but they do not maintain a persistent estimate of how the difficulty of an individual image-caption pair changes throughout training. Curriculum learning Bengio et al. (2009) orders examples by difficulty, but typically depends on a fixed or externally defined curriculum and are not adaptive noise selection. Distributionally robust optimization emphasizes difficult subpopulations Sagawa et al. (2019) , whereas frequency-aware objectives address spectral imbalance; neither directly combines the sample-level, temporal, and spectral difficulty in diffusion training. Likewise, demonstration- or feedback-conditioned language-model self-distillation cannot be transferred directly because diffusion training provides neither an in-context demonstration, nor a feedback-conditioned output distribution to distill Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) . These limitations motivate a self-referenced diffusion objective in which an easier view of the same training pair provides a relative difficulty signal rather than a teacher prediction target.
paragraphs.zh: 目前仍缺乏一个统一的解决方案，因为现有方法仅解决了该问题的一部分。噪声水平加权方法（Karras 等人，2022；Esser 等人，2024；Hang 等人，2025）会根据时间步或信噪比调整训练过程，但通常对在同一噪声水平下评估的所有示例应用相同的规则。噪声选择方法表明，不同的噪声实例提供的训练信号并不相同（Qi 等人，2024a），但这些方法并未持续估计单个图像-图像标题对在整个训练过程中的难度变化。课程学习法（Bengio 等人，2009）按难度对示例进行排序，但通常依赖于固定或外部定义的课程，并非自适应的噪声选择方法。分布鲁棒优化强调具有挑战性的子群体（Sagawa 等人，2019），而频率感知目标则旨在解决频谱失衡问题；这两种方法均未直接结合扩散训练中的样本级、时间维度和频谱层面的难度。同样，基于演示或反馈的条件语言模型自蒸馏方法也无法直接迁移，因为扩散训练既不提供上下文内的演示，也不提供可用于蒸馏的反馈条件输出分布（Shenfeld 等人，2026；Hübotter 等人，2026）。这些局限性促使我们提出一种自参考的扩散目标：其中，同一训练对的一个更简单的视图可提供相对难度信号，而非教师预测目标。

paragraphs.en: We introduce SALD, which evaluates every image-caption pair at two noise levels using one shared model: an easier low-noise path and a harder high-noise path. The easy path is evaluated without gradient tracking and serves as an internal reference, while model parameters are updated through the hard path. SALD does not directly distill the easy-path prediction into the hard path. Instead, it measures the increase in weighted prediction error from the easy path to the hard path and uses this relative signal to adapt the hard-path objective. Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) converts the scalar error difference into a normalized, differentiable sample weight, emphasizing training pairs whose error grows under the harder condition. Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) maintains an exponential moving average of relative difficulty for every training pair and uses it to adapt future noise-level gaps, forming a continuous per-example curriculum Bengio et al. (2009) . Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) compares the residual power spectra of the two paths and constructs a differentiable, frequency-derived latent-element weight, providing a finer training signal related to spectral bias Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Wang and Pehlevan (2025a) . All components reuse the same set of model parameters and require neither a teacher network nor additional trainable model parameters during training or inference. The method introduces no change to the inference procedure. Our contributions are summarized as follows:

paragraphs.en: The same diffusion model evaluates each image-caption pair at two noise levels. The lower-noise evaluation forms an easy path , which is computed without gradient tracking and serves as an internal reference. The higher-noise evaluation forms a hard path , through which the model parameters are updated. By comparing these paths, SALD addresses three questions: (i) Which examples are currently difficult? (ii) How large should the easy-to-hard noise gap be for each example? and (iii) At which frequencies does the hard-path residual remain large? Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD), Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM), and Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) address these questions, respectively. All components share the same model parameters; therefore, SALD requires neither an external teacher nor an additional trainable model during training or inference.

paragraphs.en: Quantitative Analysis: Tables 1 , and 2 report quantitative comparisons across seven benchmarks at 512 512 and 1024 1024 resolutions. SALD consistently outperforms the competing acceleration and distillation baselines, including SpeeD Wang et al. (2025) , Temporal Diff Ying et al. (2026) , and SRA Jiang et al. (2025) , across both SANA, PixArt and Flux.2 Klein architectures. In particular, SALD achieves the best FID, CLIP, and LPIPS scores across the majority of evaluated settings, demonstrating its ability to simultaneously improve generation fidelity, text-image alignment, and perceptual quality. The improvements are consistent across different model scales and datasets, with particularly substantial FID reductions observed at both 512 512 and 1024 1024 resolutions. Compared with the existing baselines, these results demonstrate that SALD provides a more effective and consistent strategy for improving diffusion model generation quality while preserving semantic alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 定量分析：表1和表2报告了七项基准测试在512×512和1024×1024分辨率下的定量对比。SALD在SANA、PixArt和Flux.2 Klein三种架构中，始终优于包括SpeeD Wang等人（2025）、Temporal Diff Ying等人（2026）和SRA Jiang等人（2025）在内的竞争性加速与蒸馏基线模型。特别地，在大多数评估设置中，SALD实现了最佳的FID、CLIP和LPIPS分数，证明了其能够同时提升生成保真度、文本-图像对齐以及感知质量。这些改进在不同模型规模和数据集上均保持一致，尤其是在512×512和1024×1024两种分辨率下，FID得分的降低尤为显著。与现有基线模型相比，这些结果表明，SALD为提升扩散模型生成质量并提供语义对齐能力提供了更高效且更稳定的策略。

paragraphs.en: Qualitative Analysis: Figures 4 and 5 present qualitative comparisons of SALD across diverse architectures, datasets, and training methods. Figure 4 compares SALD with Base, SpeeD, SRA, and Temporal Diff on SANA 0.6B and PixArt- Σ \Sigma , where SALD consistently preserves finer details, clearer structures, and prompt-specific semantic attributes, while competing methods often exhibit missing details and visual artifacts. paragraphs.en: Case 1: Individual Contributions. AGD contributes most strongly among individual components, as direct difficulty-aware reweighting provides an immediate training signal. SAD offers complementary gains through spectral routing, improving structural fidelity at the cost of modest CLIP degradation. TAM alone yields the weakest improvement, since its EMA-based memory requires a sustained difficulty signal from AGD to stabilise, a notable limitation when used in isolation. Together, all three components are necessary to close the full performance gap.
paragraphs.zh: 案例 1：个体贡献。 在个体组件中，AGD 的贡献最为显著，因为直接基于难度的重新加权能够立即提供训练信号。 SAD 通过谱路由提供了补充性的增益，提升了结构保真度，但代价是 CLIP 性能略有下降。 TAM 单独使用时提升效果最弱，因为其基于 EMA 的记忆机制需要 AGD 持续提供的难度信号才能稳定，这是单独使用时一个明显的局限性。 要完全弥补性能差距，这三种组件必须协同使用。

paragraphs.en: Denoising diffusion models Ho et al. (2020) and score-based generative models Song et al. (2020) established iterative denoising as a powerful paradigm for image synthesis. Flow matching Lipman et al. (2022) ; Albergo et al. (2025) provides a continuous-time alternative by learning velocity fields along interpolation paths. Recent transformer-based generators, including DiT Peebles and Xie (2023) , rectified-flow transformers Esser et al. (2024) , SANA Xie et al. (2024) , PixArt- α \alpha Chen et al. (2023) , and PixArt- Σ \Sigma Chen et al. (2024) , further improve scalability and high-resolution generation. However, most objectives still treat samples, timesteps, and spatial locations uniformly. Several works improve training by reallocating the gradient budget across noise levels. EDM Karras et al. (2022) studies principled noise schedules and σ \sigma -weighting, while P2 Choi et al. (2022) emphasizes perceptually important SNR regions. Improved noise schedules Hang et al. (2025) and noise-instance analysis Qi et al. (2024a) further show that different noise levels and noise samples provide unequal training signals. These approaches define global timestep-dependent weights, whereas AGD computes per-sample relative difficulty from the loss gap between low- and high-noise paths.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散模型 Ho 等人 (2020) 和基于得分的生成模型 Song 等人 (2020) 确立了迭代去噪作为图像合成的一种强大范式。 流匹配 Lipman 等人 (2022)；Albergo 等人 (2025) 通过沿插值路径学习速度场，提供了一种连续时间的替代方案。 近期的基于变压器的生成器，包括 DiT Peebles 和 Xie (2023)、修正流变压器 Esser 等人 (2024)、SANA Xie 等人 (2024)、PixArt-α \alpha Chen 等人 (2023) 以及 PixArt-Σ \Sigma Chen 等人 (2024)，进一步提升了可扩展性和高分辨率生成能力。 然而，大多数目标函数仍然对样本、时间步和空间位置进行统一处理。 一些研究通过在不同噪声水平间重新分配梯度预算来改进训练。EDM Karras 等人 (2022) 研究了基于原理的噪声调度与 σ \sigma-加权，而 P2 Choi 等人 (2022) 则强调了感知上重要的 SNR 区域。 改进的噪声调度 Hang 等人 (2025) 和噪声实例分析 Qi 等人 (2024a) 进一步表明，不同的噪声水平和噪声样本提供的训练信号并不均等。 这些方法定义了全局的、依赖于时间步的权重，而 AGD 则通过低噪声路径与高噪声路径之间的损失差异来计算每个样本的相对难度。

paragraphs.en: We presented SALD, a unified training framework for flow-based diffusion models that reallocates gradient budget across samples, noise levels, and frequency components. AGD estimates relative sample difficulty by contrasting losses between low and high-noise states, producing normalized within-batch importance weights. TAM extends this signal across the training set through persistent per-sample memory, enabling an adaptive curriculum over timestep gaps. SAD further refines optimization by converting contrastive spectral residuals into frequency-derived latent weights, emphasizing frequency patterns that remain under-learned. Since only the easy-path reference is detached, SALD preserves the original prediction target while improving where and how training effort is applied. In general, SALD offers a simple, architecture-agnostic approach for improving diffusion training without modifying the model, sampler, or inference procedure. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets and architectures demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, while theoretical analysis supports the empirical findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SALD，一个用于流基扩散模型的统一训练框架，该框架可在样本、噪声水平和频率分量之间重新分配梯度预算。 AGD 通过对比低噪声状态和高噪声状态之间的损失来估计样本的相对难度，从而生成批内归一化的重要性权重。 TAM 通过每个样本的持久化记忆将这种信号扩展到整个训练集，从而能够在时间步长间隔上实现自适应课程学习。 SAD 通过将对比性谱残差转换为源自频率的潜在权重来进一步优化优化过程，强调那些仍未被充分学习的频率模式。 由于仅解耦了“易路径”参考，SALD 在提升训练努力应用的位置和方式的同时，保留了原始预测目标。 总体而言，SALD 提供了一种简单且与架构无关的方法，可在不修改模型、采样器或推理流程的情况下改进扩散模型的训练效果。 在多种数据集和架构上进行的广泛实验证明了所提出框架的有效性，而理论分析也支持了这些实证结果。

paragraphs.en: The standard flow-matching loss used in Section 2.1 averages the losses of all training samples and all elements of their latent residuals. Apart from the time-dependent factor w ⁡ ( t ) w(t) , it assigns the same explicit coefficient to every sample and latent element. This does not mean that all samples produce equal gradients; samples with larger residuals can naturally produce larger gradient magnitudes. Rather, the objective has no explicit mechanism for adapting a sample’s importance according to its current difficulty or for distinguishing the frequency content of its remaining residual. This uniform treatment leads to two limitations that can become more important as training progresses, especially during domain-specific fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2.1 节中使用的标准流匹配损失函数，对所有训练样本及其潜在残差的各个元素进行平均计算损失值。 除了与时间相关的因子 w(t) 之外，该函数还为每个样本和潜在元素分配了相同的显式系数。 这并不意味着所有样本都会产生相等的梯度；具有较大残差的样本自然会产生更大的梯度幅值。 相反，该目标函数并没有显式的机制来根据样本当前的难度调整其重要性，或区分其剩余残差的频率成分。 这种统一的处理方式带来了两个局限性，随着训练的进行，尤其是在领域特定的微调阶段，这些局限性可能会变得更为重要。

paragraphs.en: The first limitation is at the sample level. Not all images are equally difficult for the current model. A clean portrait against a plain background may be learned early, after which its loss becomes small and further updates provide limited new information. Meanwhile, a cluttered street scene with reflections, thin text, and overlapping objects may remain difficult for much longer. Under uniform weighting, both samples retain the same explicit coefficient in the mini-batch objective, even though reallocating more emphasis to the difficult sample may be more useful. Prior work on hard-example mining and diffusion-noise selection similarly shows that examples and noise realizations can provide unequal training value Shrivastava et al. (2016) ; Qi et al. (2024b) . Consequently, uniform weighting can spend part of the finite optimization budget on already well-learned samples while under-emphasizing examples that remain difficult.

paragraphs.en: The second limitation concerns the frequency content of the residual within each image. Deep networks are known to learn low-frequency content faster than high-frequency content, a behavior referred to as spectral bias or the frequency principle Rahaman et al. (2019) ; Xu et al. (2020) . Related frequency-dependent behavior has also been studied in diffusion models Yang et al. (2023) ; Si et al. (2024) ; Wang and Pehlevan (2025a) . Smooth structures such as skies and walls may be reconstructed earlier, whereas fine details such as hair strands, feather textures, specular highlights, and small text can lag behind. However, the standard mean-squared error collapses the full latent residual into a single scalar and does not explicitly indicate which frequency bands retain comparatively large error. Importantly, frequency magnitude does not identify the spatial locations of those errors because the power spectrum discards Fourier phase. The relevant goal is therefore to identify difficult frequency components and use them to construct a frequency-derived latent weight, rather than to claim a localized pixel-level error map.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个局限性涉及每张图片中残差频率的内容。 众所周知，深度网络学习低频内容的速度比高频内容更快，这种行为被称为光谱偏差或频率原则（Rahaman 等人，2019；Xu 等人，2020）。 相关的频率依赖行为在扩散模型中也得到了研究（Yang 等人，2023；Si 等人， 2024；Wang 和 Pehlevan，2025a）。 天空和墙壁等平滑结构可能更早被重建，而发丝、羽毛纹理、镜面高光和小型文字等精细细节则可能滞后。 然而，标准的均方误差将整个潜在残差坍缩为一个单一标量，并未明确指示哪些频率带保留了相对较大的误差。 重要的是，频率幅度无法确定这些误差的空间位置，因为功率谱丢弃了傅里叶相位信息。 因此，相关目标在于识别难以处理的频率成分，并利用它们构建一个基于频率的潜在权重，而不是声称得到一个局部化的像素级误差图。

paragraphs.en: One natural idea is curriculum learning Bengio et al. (2009) ; Kumar et al. (2010) , in which easy samples are shown first and harder samples are introduced later. Classical curricula, however, often rely on a fixed notion of difficulty. In diffusion training, a sample’s difficulty changes as the model improves, so a static ordering can quickly become stale. What is needed instead is a strategy that (i) measures which samples become difficult relative to the current model when noise is increased, (ii) remembers this relative difficulty across training steps, and (iii) identifies which residual frequencies remain difficult. Unlike demonstration- or feedback-conditioned language-model self-distillation Shenfeld et al. (2026) ; Hübotter et al. (2026) , SALD constructs its reference from two noise states of the same image–caption pair: a lower-noise easy path evaluated without gradient tracking and a higher-noise hard path that supplies the training gradient. Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) performs differentiable sample-level reweighting, Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM) maintains persistent relative-difficulty estimates and adapts future noise gaps, and Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) constructs a frequency-derived latent weight. These components share one set of model parameters and require no external teacher or additional model copy during training or inference.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes a single SALD training step. Given a mini-batch of image–caption pairs, we first determine a base noise-level gap using a simple curriculum: during warm-up, the gap increases from 1 1 to Δ \Delta , after which it is sampled uniformly from { 1 , … , Δ } \{1,\ldots,\Delta\} . This base gap is then modulated for each sample using Temporal Advantage Memory (TAM), which scales the gap according to the sample’s stored difficulty score and clips it to the valid range. For each example, we sample a lower-noise easy level and obtain the corresponding higher-noise hard level by adding the TAM-adjusted gap. Two noisy views of the same latent are then constructed using independent Gaussian perturbations. The same model performs two forward passes: the easy path is evaluated under no_grad and serves as an internal reference, whereas the hard path remains differentiable and supplies the training gradient. From the residuals of these two paths, Spectral Advantage Decomposition (SAD) compares their frequency-domain error magnitudes and maps a zero-phase spectral gate back to the latent coordinates to obtain a frequency-derived weighting kernel. Since this construction does not retain the residual phase or recover the locations of the original errors, the kernel should not be interpreted as a localized pixel-level advantage map. Instead, it reweights the hard-path residual loss using the relative spectral errors of the two paths. In parallel, Advantage-Guided Diffusion (AGD) defines the sample advantage as the difference between the differentiable hard-path loss and the stop-gradient easy-path reference loss. It converts this advantage into a normalized sample weight that emphasizes harder examples within the batch. Finally, TAM stores the numerical advantage for future visits to the sample; the memory is non-trainable, and no gradient is propagated through this state update. The SALD objective is then formed by averaging the sample-weighted SAD losses of the hard paths before backpropagation. In this way, the algorithm adapts the training signal across samples, noise levels, and spectral components through a dynamic, self-referenced curriculum.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了单个 SALD 训练步骤。 给定一个图像-标题对的小批量数据，我们首先通过一个简单的课程策略确定基础噪声水平差距：在预热阶段，该差距从 1 增加到 Δ，之后从 {1, …, Δ} 中均匀采样。 随后，利用时间优势记忆（TAM）对每个样本的基础差距进行调整，TAM 会根据样本存储的难度分数缩放该差距，并将其限制在有效范围内。 对于每个示例，我们采样一个低噪声的简单级别，并通过添加经 TAM 调整的差距来获得对应的更高噪声的困难级别。 接着，使用独立的高斯扰动为同一潜在变量构建两个带噪声的视图。 同一模型执行两次前向传播：简单路径在无梯度模式下进行评估并作为内部参考，而困难路径保持可微分性并提供训练梯度。 从这两条路径的残差中，光谱优势分解（SAD）比较它们的频域误差幅度，并将一个零相位光谱门映射回潜在坐标，以获得频率相关的加权核。 由于这种构造既未保留残差相位，也未恢复原始错误的位置，因此不应将该核解释为局部像素级的优势图。 相反，它利用两条路径的相对光谱误差对困难路径的残差损失进行重新加权。 同时，优势引导扩散（AGD）将样本优势定义为可微分的困难路径损失与停止梯度的简单路径参考损失之差。 它将此优势转换为归一化的样本权重，以强调批量中更困难的示例。 最后，TAM 会存储数值优势以便后续访问该样本；该记忆不可训练，且没有梯度通过此状态更新传播。 随后，在反向传播之前，SALD 目标函数通过对困难路径的样本加权 SAD 损失求平均而形成。 通过这种方式，该算法借助动态的自我参考课程策略，跨样本、噪声水平和光谱成分调整训练信号。

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the training efficiency of SALD under a matched wall-clock budget. As shown in Table 5 , SALD incurs approximately 25 % 25\% additional wall-clock time per training step compared with the corresponding baseline, measured on the same NVIDIA RTX A6000 setup. This overhead comes from the additional easy noise reference path: SALD performs gradient computation and backpropagation only for the hard noise path, while the easy noise path is evaluated without gradient computation, requiring only an additional forward pass. To account for this overhead, SALD is trained for 10 10 k steps, while the baselines are trained for 12.5 12.5 k steps. Thus, the total training budgets are approximately matched, since 10 ​ k × 1.25 ≈ 12.5 ​ k 10\text{k}\times 1.25\approx 12.5\text{k} . As reported in Table 5 , under this comparable wall-clock budget, SALD consistently achieves better generation quality across both CUB-200 and MultiGen datasets. In particular, SALD improves FID, CLIP, and LPIPS over the corresponding baseline models across all evaluated backbone configurations. These results show that the limited additional cost introduced by the no-gradient reference path is compensated by SALD’s faster convergence, allowing it to achieve superior generation quality within approximately the same overall training time as the baselines.

paragraphs.en: The behavior is consistent with the relative error signal introduced in Eq. 6 . Instead of treating prediction errors at different noise states independently, SALD contrasts the hard and easy states of the same sample and assigns greater importance when the harder state exhibits a larger error. Through the AGD weighting in Eq. 7 , optimization therefore concentrates on trajectory regions where prediction remains comparatively difficult. This encourages more accurate learning of the velocity field along challenging portions of the noise trajectory, which in turn reduces the dependence on densely spaced inference updates. The cross-scale results in Table 6 suggest that this effect is not specific to a particular architecture size, but translates into consistently stronger quality–efficiency trade-offs across the evaluated models.

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, Figure 8 provides a qualitative view of this faster inference-time convergence using SANA 1.6B trained on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 1M. The distinction is most pronounced at low sampling budgets. SALD establishes the correct facial structure and overall appearance within the first few steps, with the 10-step output already closely resembling its 15- and 20-step generations. In contrast, the baseline remains highly unstable at 5 and 10 steps, exhibiting substantial changes in geometry, illumination, and color before converging toward a consistent image at later steps. Thus, additional sampling primarily refines the SALD output rather than correcting its global structure, whereas the baseline requires more iterations to stabilize both structure and appearance. This visual progression further supports that SALD learns a more efficient generation trajectory, allowing coherent samples to emerge under substantially fewer inference steps.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，图 8 通过使用在 DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 1M 上训练的 SANA 1.6B，直观展示了这种推理阶段更快的收敛过程。 在采样预算较低时，这种差异最为显著。 SALD 在前几个步骤内就确立了正确的人脸结构和整体外观，其 10 步的输出已经与 15 步和 20 步的生成结果非常接近。 相比之下，基线模型在 5 步和 10 步时仍然极不稳定，在几何结构、光照和颜色方面出现显著变化，直到后续步骤才逐渐收敛为一致的图片。 因此，额外的采样主要对 SALD 的输出进行优化，而非修正其整体结构；而基线模型则需要更多迭代才能稳定结构和外观。 这种视觉上的演变过程进一步证明，SALD 学习到了更高效的生成路径，从而在远较少的推理步骤内就能生成连贯的样本。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether the gains reported at the main training budget are a consequence of insufficient training of the Baseline, we extend both the Baseline and SALD models to 100 100 k training steps, corresponding to 10 × 10\times the standard 10 10 k-step training budget. Table 7 reports the results across SANA 1.6B and SANA 0.6B on the MultiGen and Oxford 102 Flowers datasets. SALD maintains a consistent FID advantage over the corresponding Baseline throughout the extended training horizon, while CLIP and LPIPS remain comparable. For example, at 10 10 k steps, SALD already achieves substantially lower FID than the Baseline, reducing it from 26.44 26.44 to 23.86 23.86 on MultiGen and from 33.11 33.11 to 27.37 27.37 on Oxford 102 Flowers with SANA 1.6B. Importantly, this advantage does not disappear as training continues, demonstrating that the improvements observed at the main 10 10 k-step setting are not simply a consequence of under-training the Baseline.

paragraphs.en: The extended training results also reveal diminishing returns at later stages of optimization. After approximately 80 80 k steps, both models improve more slowly. SALD maintains a clear FID advantage over the Baseline in this later regime: the gap remains stable on MultiGen ( 2.58 2.58 at both 10 10 k and 100 100 k for SANA 1.6B) and narrows but persists on Oxford 102 Flowers (from 5.74 5.74 to 3.71 3.71 for SANA 1.6B and from 4.81 4.81 to 3.57 3.57 for SANA 0.6B). Thus, extending training to 100 100 k steps does not eliminate the advantage of SALD. Instead, the results demonstrate that the gain introduced by SALD persists throughout the extended training process, while further optimization beyond 80 80 k steps provides only marginal improvements for either method. These observations support the use of 10 10 k steps as a practical training budget for the main experiments and confirm that the reported improvements are not due to premature termination of Baseline training.

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 presents qualitative comparisons between baseline finetuning and SALD across multiple architectures on the MAGICK and DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 1M datasets at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. Similarly, on DALL ⋅ \cdot E 3 1M, baseline generations exhibit inconsistent hand–object interactions, oversmoothed hair textures, and weaker illumination consistency around the magical orb. In contrast, SALD generates more stable anatomy, finer hair strands, improved lighting coherence, and stronger object-boundary preservation. These improvements are consistent across SANA and PixArt variants, demonstrating that SALD effectively enhances high-frequency detail generation and semantic consistency at high resolutions.

paragraphs.en: Figure 11 presents qualitative generations produced by SALD across diverse datasets, resolutions, and backbone architectures, demonstrating both visual fidelity and semantic consistency. paragraphs.en: SALD evaluates each training example through two noise levels using the same diffusion model: the lower-noise easy path provides an internal reference under no_grad , whereas the higher-noise hard path supplies the training gradient. Consequently, SALD requires neither an external teacher nor additional trainable model parameters during training or inference. Nevertheless, the additional easy-path evaluation increases the per-step training cost by approximately 25 % 25\% . Although our wall-clock-matched experiments (Table 5 ) show that the resulting improvement in optimization efficiency can offset this overhead, reducing the per-step training cost remains an important direction for future work. One possibility is to cache easy-path reference predictions from earlier checkpoints. However, such cached predictions would become stale as the model changes and would depart from the formulation considered in this work, where the reference is always computed with the current model parameters.
paragraphs.zh: SALD 使用相同的扩散模型，通过两种噪声水平对每个训练示例进行评估：低噪声的简单路径在 no_grad 条件下提供内部参考，而高噪声的困难路径则提供训练梯度。 因此，SALD 在训练或推理过程中既不需要外部教师模型，也不需要额外的可训练模型参数。 然而，额外的简单路径评估使每一步的训练成本增加了约 25%（25\%）。 尽管与我们在壁钟时间上匹配的实验（表 5）表明，由此带来的优化效率提升可以抵消这一额外开销，但降低每一步的训练成本仍然是未来工作的重要方向。 一种可能性是缓存来自早期检查点的简单路径参考预测。 然而，随着模型的变化，这类缓存的预测会变得过时，并且会偏离本研究中采用的公式，因为该公式中的参考始终使用当前的模型参数进行计算。

paragraphs.en: TAM stores one non-trainable scalar for each training sample. This memory cost is negligible for the dataset sizes considered in our experiments but grows linearly with the number of training examples. Moreover, TAM updates a sample’s memory only when that sample is revisited, so its curriculum effect is weaker when each example is seen only a few times during training. For extremely large web-scale datasets, group-level, clustered, or compressed difficulty statistics could reduce this cost and increase the update frequency, although such approximations may sacrifice the precision of the per-sample curriculum.
paragraphs.zh: TAM 为每个训练样本存储一个不可训练的标量。 在我们实验中考虑的数据集规模下，这种内存开销可以忽略不计，但会随着训练样本数量的增加而线性增长。 此外，TAM 仅在重新访问某个样本时才会更新其记忆，因此当每个样本在训练期间仅被看到几次时，其课程学习效应会较弱。 对于极其庞大的网络级数据集，采用组级、聚类或压缩的难度统计方法可以降低这种开销并提高更新频率，尽管此类近似可能会牺牲单个样本课程学习的精确性。

paragraphs.en: Finally, our empirical evaluation is limited to fine-tuning pretrained text-to-image flow-matching models; we do not evaluate SALD for training from scratch. Our convergence analysis also holds only for a fixed TAM memory state (Remark 4). While we describe how the same easy–hard self-referencing principle can be extended to DDPM-style noise-prediction objectives, we do not experimentally validate that extension in this work. Evaluating SALD with noise-prediction models, in from-scratch training, and in other generative modalities, including video and 3D generation, remain directions for future research.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们的实证评估仅限于对预训练的文本到图像流匹配模型进行微调；我们并未评估从头开始训练 SALD 的情况。 我们的收敛分析也仅适用于固定的 TAM 内存状态（注 4）。 尽管我们描述了如何将相同的“易–难”自引用原则扩展到 DDPM 风格的噪声预测目标，但我们在本研究中并未对该扩展进行实验验证。 在从头训练以及视频和 3D 生成等其他生成模态中，使用噪声预测模型评估 SALD，仍然是未来研究的方向。
